provisionalSurvivor.name: Requirement–Assignment–Constraint Projection
provisionalSurvivor.compression: Composition is a context-bound satisfiability/proof problem, not a global Resource graph. For actor/transition/demand/load/as_of, domain-authored requirements are assigned current ResourceFor/ActionableResourceFor projections under native compatibility, authority/currentness, capacity, temporal/effect/recovery and disturbance constraints. Substitution/complementarity/prerequisite/modifier/bottleneck/redundancy are derived relations. Persist exact bundle identity only at an owner-native action/effect/recovery boundary that requires it.

centralResult: Composition is provisionally a context-bound requirement-assignment-constraint proof, not a property of a Resource bag or a universal dependency graph. Substitution, complementarity, prerequisite, conversion modifier, bottleneck and redundancy are derived relations over feasible assignments.

rootCompression.persistenceRule: Persist exact composition identity only where one owner-native admission/effect/recovery boundary requires exact member identity; recompute planning composition elsewhere.

implementationEvidence.currentGap: Current World resource evaluator is per-candidate and cannot satisfy a conjunctive demand x+y from separate x and y Resources.
implementationEvidence.control: A lower-owner Resource exporting composite semantic capability x+y is consumable-now, showing that lower-owner composition plus semantic export remains the preferred path when one owner can own the whole capability.
